horizontal_right_candidate.interpretation: Exact pixels, but its widget location is not established; excluded from scrollbar conclusions.

results.horizontal_left: No exact matching cell was found in this window capture.

vm_identity.wake_operation: Shift field cleared; done=true; frame=65; held=false; no error
